title: Model Paper 4
html:
MODEL PAPER 2 — MECEE-BL (Group I). Time: 3 hours. Full marks: 200. Attempt all questions. Each question has four options with one best answer; choose the best and mark it on your answer grid. Each correct answer carries 1 mark and each wrong answer deducts 0.25 mark. Calculators are not allowed; do rough work in the margins. Sit this paper in one uninterrupted sitting, exactly as on the day.

How to score yourself: score = (number correct) − 0.25 × (number wrong). Do not leave blanks — in this marking scheme even a blind guess is worth +1/16 of a mark. Record your correct/wrong/blank counts per subject before you open the key.

This paper follows the official unit weightage exactly:
